newsitem.title: USA: Barr Labs gets FDA OK for generic menopause drug.
newsitem.headline: Barr Labs gets FDA OK for generic menopause drug.

text.p: Barr Laboratories Inc said on Monday it has received U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval to market Estropipate tablets, the generic equivalent of Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc's OGEN, to treat symptoms associated with menopause.
Barr's Estropipate will be available in three strengths -- 0.75 mg, 1.5 mg and three mg, the company said.
Barr is the third company bringing a generic version of this product to market, the company said. Sales are expected early 1997, the company said.
